# Ezekiel 38 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-the-word-of YHWH came to-me, saying:

**2** "Son-of-man, set your-face against Gog, of-the-land-of Magog, the-chief prince-of Meshech and-Tubal, and-prophesy against-him."

**3** And-YHWH declared concerning Gog and-Gog of Magog invades — His-power-over the-forces-of chaos.

**23** "And-I-will-magnify-Myself and-sanctify-Myself and-make-Myself-known before-the-eyes-of many nations; and-they-will-know that I [am] YHWH."

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **38:1**: Opening formula for the oracle concerning Gog of Magog invades — prophetic context established.

- **38:11**: Central imagery of the great end-time battle — integral to Ezekiel's prophetic architecture.

- **38:23**: Concluding formula — the divine word stands as spoken concerning God's sovereignty over apocalyptic forces.

— EMET
